title: Source Ledger Trust Accounting: licensed source-finder rows count honestly

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.64 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow source-ledger trust-accounting repair; focused source and package-export coverage plus normal local gates and gold smoke are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is driven by v0.15.62/v0.15.63 audit evidence and local regressions; another deployed provider audit is required after deploy.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: The release keeps the latest 96/A Project Management evidence visible and treats source proof loss as a CourseMapper bridge/accounting issue, not a model-only issue.
Source ledger summaries now count trusted rows only when rows are accessible, non-ambiguous, and provider-eligible.
Crossref and Wikipedia source-finder evidence preserves provider identity and normalizes trust level/license ambiguity without collapsing to generic syllabus proof.
The source-ledger quality checker now reports sourceRef thinness using the strict trusted-row definition, so public metadata and review rows do not inflate source proof.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit and verify trusted, concept-linked source rows reach PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json and SOURCE_REPORT.md.
If source points remain below target, inspect whether retrieval failed, source-finder resources were lost during repair, or CourseIR sourceRef coverage did not bridge.
Improve slide-deck substance so enriched lesson kernels produce enough content-bearing deck slides.
Continue deterministic texture variation/post-processing until texture reaches 100.
